descriptor.name: Alaska combined local-government parcels (AK_Parcels) — statewide
descriptor.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational; users choose their source and intended use.
descriptor.operator: Unattributed ArcGIS Online compilation of Alaska local-government parcel data
descriptor.scope: Combined parcel data from 20 Alaska local governments (boroughs, municipalities and one regional fund). parcel_id is the local government's own number, so the native key is local_gov plus parcel_id.
caveats: Publisher not identified in service metadata; local governments not among the 20 local_gov values observed on 2026-10-12 are absent.
The local_gov label is part of the identity; a relabelled local government would change canonical IDs.
Rows with null or blank parcel_id (2,613 statewide on 2026-10-12) are excluded; 218 parcel_id values carry leading or trailing spaces and are kept verbatim.
Layer also publishes owner and value fields, which are not requested.
descriptor.attribution: Alaska local governments; compiled ArcGIS Online layer AK_Parcels. Adapted to WGS84.

jurisdiction.basis: Service description "Combined land parcel data from various local government bodies in Alaska"; 20 local governments present on 2026-10-12, so coverage is partial by construction.

evidence: Service description "Combined land parcel data from various local government bodies in Alaska"; 20 local governments present on 2026-10-12, so coverage is partial by construction.
